description: This file defines the AliasRepository class in the Drupal path_alias module, providing methods for path alias lookup operations including preload, lookup by system path or alias, and path matching, with support for language fallback.

classes.name: AliasRepository
classes.description: Provides path alias lookup operations, including preload, lookup by path or alias, and path matching with language fallback support.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the AliasRepository with a database connection.

methods.name: preloadPathAlias
methods.description: Preloads path aliases for given paths and language code, returning an associative array of path to alias.

methods.name: lookupBySystemPath
methods.description: Looks up an alias by system path and language code, returning alias info or null.

methods.name: lookupByAlias
methods.description: Looks up a system path by alias and language code, returning path info or null.

methods.name: pathHasMatchingAlias
methods.description: Checks if any path has an alias starting with the given initial substring.

methods.name: getBaseQuery
methods.description: Returns a base SELECT query for the path_alias table with status=1.

methods.name: addLanguageFallback
methods.description: Adds language fallback conditions to a query, ordering by language code appropriately.
